items.title: Preventive care
items.imageAlt: A vaccine being prepared for immunization and preventive care.
items.homeImageAlt: A vaccine being prepared for immunization and preventive care.
items.description: Routine checkups, screenings, immunizations, and lifestyle guidance that help patients stay ahead of health concerns.
items: Routine checkups and annual physical exams
Screening for conditions such as high blood pressure, diabetes, high cholesterol, and certain cancers
items.fit: Annual physicals, prevention planning, and wellness support for patients age {minimumAge} and up.
items.boundary: Some preventive screenings, labs, or procedures may require coordination with an in-person facility.

items.title: Diagnosis and treatment of common illnesses
items.imageAlt: A clinician checking a patient's eyes during a routine health visit.
items.homeImageAlt: A clinician checking a patient's eyes during a routine health visit.
items.description: Timely evaluation and treatment guidance for everyday illnesses, minor injuries, and common acute concerns.
items: Colds, flu, sore throat, and other infections
items.fit: Acute symptoms that can be safely reviewed through the visit process.
items.boundary: Severe symptoms, breathing trouble, chest pain, major injuries, or rapidly worsening concerns need urgent care.

items.title: Management of chronic diseases
items.imageAlt: A blood pressure check during chronic disease management follow-up.
items.homeImageAlt: A blood pressure check during chronic disease management follow-up.
items.description: Ongoing support for long-term conditions, with education, monitoring, and clear next steps.
items: Asthma and chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD)
items.fit: Stable chronic condition follow-up, medication questions, and care planning.
items.boundary: Unstable readings, severe symptoms, or complex medication changes may require higher-touch or in-person care.

items.title: Mental health services
items.imageAlt: A clinician speaking with a patient in a calm care conversation.
items.homeImageAlt: A clinician speaking with a patient in a calm care conversation.
items.description: Screening, basic counseling, medication management for common conditions, and specialist referral when needed.
items: Screening for depression, anxiety, and substance use
Medication management for common mental health conditions
Referral to mental health specialists when needed
items.fit: Patients who need screening, early support, or coordinated mental health next steps.
items.boundary: Crisis symptoms, suicidal thoughts, or urgent behavioral health needs require emergency or crisis services right away.
